task_fulfilment.comment_en: You thank Sophie, accept, offer to bring a cake and ask practical questions; the arrival time is in a past tense although Saturday is still to come.
task_fulfilment.comment_zh: 你感谢了 Sophie，接受了邀请，提出带蛋糕，也问了实际问题；但星期六还没到，到达时间却用了过去时。

clarity.comment_en: Clear and easy to follow; three sentences start the same way.
clarity.comment_zh: 清楚易懂；有三个句子的开头一样。

corrections.hint_en: Saturday has not happened yet: which tense talks about the future?
corrections.hint_zh: 星期六还没到：哪个时态表示将来？
corrections.reason_en: An arrival planned for Saturday needs the futur simple, not the passé composé.
corrections.reason_zh: 计划在星期六到达，要用简单将来时，不能用复合过去时。

corrections.hint_en: In writing, a negation keeps both of its parts.
corrections.hint_zh: 书面语中，否定要保留两个部分。
corrections.reason_en: Dropping « ne » belongs to spoken French; an email keeps it.
corrections.reason_zh: 省略 « ne » 是口语用法，邮件里要保留。

corrections.hint_en: Three sentences start the same way; can you vary one of them?
corrections.hint_zh: 有三个句子开头相同，能换一种说法吗？
corrections.reason_en: Varied sentence openings read more naturally.
corrections.reason_zh: 句子开头有变化，读起来更自然。

corrections.hint_en: Start the reply by accepting clearly.
corrections.hint_zh: 回信开头要明确表示接受。
corrections.reason_en: A clear acceptance answers the invitation first.
corrections.reason_zh: 先明确接受，才算回应了邀请。
